note: ITA egress permanent (#36423501): every ITA server-side call through the dedicated mTLS gateway (fails closed when unconfigured), OAuth exchange bounded at 20 s, never re-send an Approval that may have reached ITA (#692), OAuth requests invoices_scope, sanitized provider diagnostics (undocumented statuses + documented 400 error list) kept in the audit only. No one-shot routes, tickets, run windows or the temporary OAuth-only block (guarded).

lib/services/billing/authority/billing-a.reason: pure (in-memory doubles, no DB/network): an Approval that may have reached ITA is never POSTed again — POST counting across 401/timeouts/5xx/malformed bodies, concurrent executions, DB failure after the POST; FAILED only for provably-unsent; reserve is compare-and-set

pure (throw-away local CA + loopback only): egress config fails closed (missing/blank/invalid env, Production without config), host allowlist refuses any non-ITA destination before I/O, mTLS identity and proxy origin are enforced, no secret material in errors or diagnostics

pure (static scan + local refusal): the temporary OAuth-only block, its allowances and the one-shot routes/tickets never return to lib/ or app/; an unconfigured egress refuses Approval and token calls before network I/O
pure (stub fetch): the OAuth code exchange is bounded at 20 s and a timeout is recorded as outcome-uncertain, never as a failure that invites a retry with the same code

pure (capturing stub fetch): invoices_scope at authorize and code exchange only, refresh unchanged, Approval sends no extra credential header, 401/403 diagnostics keep only allowlisted bounded fields and drop anything token-like

pure (stub fetch + execution doubles): a documented 400 keeps a bounded error list (code/param/location/short message) and the gateway transaction id in the audit only; dealer/id digits masked, tokens/emails/markup dropped, the submission column keeps only our own code

pure (throw-away local CA + stub transport + in-memory doubles, no DB/network): the PRODUCTION pilot gate is off by default and fails closed on any malformed allowlist; OAuth start (incl. elevated-admin cross-tenant), callback, refresh, validation, Approval and Decision refuse a non-pilot business before any state change, token work or send; the egress refuses an unscoped or non-admitted PRODUCTION request before I/O; every authority client uses a scoped fetch
